title: Commercial-Use Mileage Share and Term — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
Under the Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty program, a line's commercial-use figures apply when the vehicle carrying the set is in commercial use. Each line states what share of its warranted miles applies under commercial use and the warranty term that applies in place of the ordinary term, counted in calendar months from the purchase date.

| Line | Share of warranted miles under commercial use | Commercial-use warranty term |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline Value Touring 40K Treadwear Warranty | 0% | 0 (no treadwear coverage for commercial use) |
| Crestline All-Season 50K Treadwear Warranty | 0% | 0 (no treadwear coverage for commercial use) |
| Crestline Grand Touring 60K Treadwear Warranty | 30% | 36 months |
| Crestline Highway Terrain LT 65K Treadwear Warranty | 50% | 48 months |
| Crestline Premium Touring 75K Treadwear Warranty | 40% | 36 months |
| Crestline Ultra Touring 85K Treadwear Warranty | 40% | 36 months |

A share of 0% means the line carries no treadwear coverage for commercial use; its commercial-use term is likewise 0.

**Worked figures (hypothetical vehicle):** on the Crestline Grand Touring 60K Treadwear Warranty line, 30% of 60,000 warranted miles is 18,000 miles, with a 36-month term; on the Crestline Highway Terrain LT 65K Treadwear Warranty line, 50% of 65,000 is 32,500 miles, with a 48-month term; on the 75K and 85K lines, 40% gives 30,000 and 34,000 miles, each with a 36-month term.
